newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Quality Dining cut to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Quality Dining cut to hold.

text.p: -- Montgomery Securities confirmed that analyst John Weiss cut his rating of Quality Dining Inc from buy to hold.
-- Weiss lowered 1997 estimates from $1.15 a share to $1.02 and 1998 profit estimates from $1.65 to $1.55, according to a source at the firm.
-- The reduction in estimates reflects a lower assumption for average volumes at company-operated Bruegger's Bagels as well as lower restaurant level profits, the source said.
-- The stock fell 2 to 17-3/8 and hit a new 52-week low of 17-1/4 during trading.
